cues.zh: 在这个项目中，我们引入了一种名为 Ambient Backscatter 的新型无线原语，它让无需电池即可计算和通信的交互式设备成为可能。
cues.en: >>In this project we introduce a new wireless primitive called Ambient Backscatter that enables interactive devices that compute and communicate without any batteries.

cues.zh: 为了直观展示我们的研究目标，我们制作了完全无需电池、却能与用户交互并与其他设备通信的设备。
cues.en: >>To create a visual sense of what we have set out to do, we created devices that have no batteries and yet can interact with users and communicate with other devices.

cues.zh: 在这里，用户通过滑动左侧设备的触摸传感器来发起通信，右侧设备闪烁 LED 来确认接收。
cues.en: >>Here the user initiates communications by swiping the touch sensor on the left device. The right device blinks an LED to confirm reception.

cues.zh: 最酷的是，这两个设备都没有安装任何电池。
cues.en: >>The cool thing here is that neither of these devices have any batteries.

cues.zh: Ambient Backscatter 通过利用我们周围已有的信号来实现无线通信，而不是自行生成信号。
cues.en: >>Ambient Backscatter enables wireless communication by leveraging the signals all around us, instead of generating our own.

cues.zh: 假设 Alice 和 Bob 这两个设备需要通信，Alice 可以通过吸收或反射附近电视塔的信号，来向 Bob 发送消息。
cues.en: >>Say two devices, Alice and Bob, need to communicate. Alice can send a message to Bob by either absorbing or reflecting signals from a nearby TV tower.

cues.zh: 比如，Alice 通过吸收所有射入的电视信号来发送比特 0，通过反射这些电视信号来发送比特 1。
cues.en: >>So for example, Alice sends a 0 bit by absorbing all the incident TV signals and a 1 bit by reflecting these TV signals.

cues.zh: Alice 和 Bob 自身不产生射频信号，也不使用电池。因此环境反向散射实现了“凭空”的无线通信。
cues.en: >>Alice and Bob do not generate their own RF signals, and they use no batteries. Thus Ambient Backscatter enables wireless communication out of thin air.

cues.zh: 这里我们演示一个离线支付应用。每张卡内都有一定的余额。
cues.en: >>Here we demonstrate an offline payment application. Each card has some onboard value.

cues.zh: 这台电池供电的支付终端读取并显示了 100 号卡的初始数值。它的初始余额是 110。
cues.en: >>This battery-powered payment terminal reads and displays the initial value in card 100. Its initial balance is 110.

cues.zh: 然后在没有终端的情况下，按下 209 号卡上的按钮，就能直接转账给 100 号卡；整个交易都由环境射频能量供电。
cues.en: >>Then with no terminal present, touching a button on card #209 transfers funds directly to card 100; the entire transaction is powered by ambient RF.

cues.zh: 现在我们用支付终端查看 100 号卡的新余额。它已经增加到了 130。
cues.en: >>Now we use the payment terminal to check the new balance on card 100. It has increased to 130.

cues.zh: 这只是其中一个例子，展示了我们如何利用现有无线信号同时作为能量来源和通信媒介。
cues.en: >>This is just one example of what we can enable by using existing wireless signals as both a source of power and a communication medium.

cues.zh: 现在想象这样一个世界：钥匙、钱包和太阳镜等日常物品都配备了环境反向散射标签。
cues.en: >>Now imagine a world where everyday objects such as keys, wallets, and sunglasses are enabled with Ambient Backscatter tags.

cues.zh: 这些微小的无电池设备可以利用环境中的WIFI、电视或蜂窝信号相互通信并实现自我定位。
cues.en: >>These tiny battery-free devices can leverage ambient WIFI, TV, or cellular signals to communicate with each other and localize themselves.

cues.zh: 例如，如果一个人丢了钥匙，沙发可以通过环境反向散射与丢失的钥匙通信，并提醒用户。
cues.en: >>For example, if a person loses his keys the couch can use Ambient Backscatter to communicate with the lost keys and alert the user.

cues.zh: 这项技术将推动智能家居、智能城市和物联网的发展。
cues.en: >>This technology will enable smart homes, smart cities and an internet of things.

cues.zh: 微小的环境反向散射设备还可以深度嵌入混凝土墙、地板或屋顶等难以触及的位置。
cues.en: >>Tiny Ambient Backscatter devices can also be embedded deeply into inaccessible sites such as concrete walls, floors, or roofs.

cues.zh: >>由于嵌入式设备没有电池，它们可以永久运行，也无需维护。
cues.en: >>Since the embedded devices have no battery, they last forever and require zero maintenance.

cues.zh: >>这类标签可以利用环境信号进行感知和通信，从而支持长期居家监测和工业应用。
cues.en: >>Such tags can leverage ambient signals for sensing and communication, and enable long-term home monitoring and industrial applications.

cues.zh: >>除了这些示例应用，我们还将现有的环境射频信号转化为电源和通信媒介。
cues.en: >>Beyond these example applications, what we are doing is transforming existing ambient RF signals into a source of power and a communication medium.

cues.zh: >>这项新功能可以在多个应用领域创造机会。
cues.en: >>This new functionality can create opportunities in multiple application domains.
